qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Decentralized branch-led credit culture (Church principle) maintained since 1970 delivers peer-leading cost-to-income and near-zero loan loss ratios across multiple Nordic real estate cycles; pricing power sustained via sticky primary-bank relationship deposits. Disintermediation from digital fintechs and Swedish mortgage price competition remain primary erosion risks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (REJECT). Despite a legendary decentralized branch model (Wallander Church principle) and industry-leading credit loss discipline, Handelsbanken is a fractional-reserve commercial deposit bank with ~10-15x leverage (SEK 1.69T debt/borrowing vs SEK 199B equity) and inherent asset-liability duration mismatch, failing the Munger peace-of-mind balance sheet standard.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median ROE of ~12-14% with peer-lowest loan loss ratio (<0.05% of loans) and strong CET1 capital (>18.5%). Operating cash flow is structurally volatile (-SEK 46.3B in FY2025, -SEK 39.8B in FY2022) reflecting lending book fluctuations, and total liabilities of ~SEK 3.1T require continuous wholesale funding and covered bond market access.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
